ValidationRule.description: The Recommended Actions Other field must have a value if "Other" is a selected option in the Recommended Actions field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Recommended_Actions_Other__c ), INCLUDES( Recommended_Actions__c , 'Other'), RecordTypeId <> '012d00000021xGL' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Recommended Actions Other is required when Recommended Actions is "Other".
